solutions.title: Copy values except the target
solutions.strategy: Copy all values into an array, skip the index that must be removed, then build a new linked list.

timeComplexity.explanation: The input is scanned once to collect values and the rebuilt list is produced with another linear pass.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The value array and rebuilt chain scale with the number of input nodes.

solutions.title: Two-pointer gap deletion
solutions.strategy: Move a fast pointer n nodes ahead, then advance fast and slow together so slow stops before the node to delete.

timeComplexity.explanation: The fast pointer advances through the list once, and the slow pointer follows within that same traversal.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A dummy node and two pointers are enough to unlink the target node in place.
